hypothesis: For an unhedged JPY investor, QQQ80+GLD20 improves realized tail risk versus QQQ100 and QQQ80+SPY20 across fixed periods while keeping CAGR drag versus QQQ within 3 percentage points.

required_in_every_fixed_period: QQQ80_GLD20 maximum drawdown is no worse than QQQ100 and QQQ80_SPY20
QQQ80_GLD20 95% daily Expected Shortfall is no worse than both benchmarks
QQQ80_GLD20 annualized volatility is no higher than both benchmarks
QQQ80_GLD20 CAGR is no more than 3 percentage points below QQQ100

data_contract.asset_prices: Yahoo Chart adjusted close using the existing investor2 provider contract
data_contract.fx_source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System H.10 Data Download Program
data_contract.fx_observation_convention: Federal Reserve H.10 daily noon buying rate
data_contract.alignment: Exact-date intersection only; no forward fill, interpolation, or alternate-feed fallback
data_contract.portfolio: Monthly fixed weights; one-way turnover cost 20 bps; initial entry cost excluded equally; risk-free rate 0; annualization 252
data_contract.expected_shortfall: Mean of the worst ceil(5% * observations) daily portfolio returns

decision.use: The existing fixed 20% gold tail-risk sleeve remains usable for unhedged JPY capital-allocation research: the pre-registered tail-risk gates passed in both fixed subperiods and the full sample after JPY translation.
do_not_use: Do not treat gold as a regime-independent Sharpe enhancer; in 2020-08 through 2023-12 its JPY Sharpe was below both QQQ100 and QQQ80_SPY20.
Do not infer that 20% is a globally optimal gold weight.
Do not use these Federal Reserve noon FX observations as an exact brokerage-close JPY mark.

limitations: Federal Reserve H.10 is a daily noon buying-rate series, while ETF adjusted closes are U.S. market closes; this is an official daily JPY translation, not a synchronous close-to-close FX mark.
Exact-date intersection leaves 1511 common price/FX dates versus 1528 ETF price dates; no missing FX dates were filled.
Yahoo Chart adjusted close is a vendor total-return series, not an exchange-consolidated SIP source.
Taxes and investor-specific account treatment are not modeled.
